messages:
ana: Quick check -- SLO tiles in staging are showing "alerts: 4" even though route-level quiet was toggled on. Owners are getting confused.
ben: Repro. Quiet prevents outbound notify but the budget widget still moves.
clare: Is it a frontend bug or the summary API returning raw numbers?
ben: Summary API returns `signal_total` and `notify_candidates`. UI used `signal_total` to compute burn. Quieting happens downstream at fanout.
diego: That means API semantics are ambiguous. Consumers expect a single "burn" value that matches what actually goes out.
nana: (typo) I mean ana: Proposal: server adds `effective_burn` (server-side suppression applied) and `quiet_info` with `active`/`expires_at`. Ship behind minor version and FF.
clare: UI changes: prefer `effective_burn` if present, show raw as secondary labeled "raw signals" and show a small pill: "Quiet — notifications paused until <ts>".
ben: Also caching: frontend caches `/slo/summary` for 30s; this makes brief quiet windows look worse. Suggest lowering TTL to 5s for tenant-scoped cards.
diego: Telemetry: emit `slo.signals.raw` and `slo.signals.effective` with tag `quiet=true/false` and a derived `slo.signals.diff`. Alert if diff > 10 for > 5m during rollout.
nana: (again) ana: Backend impl note: compute `suppressed_count` as union of suppression intervals over the aggregation window (handle overlapping policies). Add unit tests for unions and late-arriving events.
clare: UX nit: when we show both numbers make raw less visually prominent. Also add a short rollout banner: "Staged quiet-aware counting active numbers may differ" for canary tenants.
ben: I'll draft RFC + server PR. Diego, can you own telemetry and alert rule?
diego: Yes. I'll add a prometheus counter and a metric for deltas, and a Grafana panel to compare raw vs effective for canary cohort.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled on staging @ 2026-04-05T09:00:00Z tag=quiet-aware-slo. Rollout plan: feature-flagged server -> console reads flag -> smoke test -> promote.
nana: Assignments: ben server PR, clare UI copy + TTL change, diego telemetry. Sync 15m tomorrow 11:00 PT.
clare: I'll include example response in PR docs: ```{ "signal_total": 120, "suppressed_count": 115, "effective_burn": 5, "quiet_info": "2026-04-05T09:30:00Z" }```
ben: Make suppressed_count an int and timestamps ISO in docs. Also include migration note for integrators.
diego: Don't forget tests for overlapping quiet from tenant+route and for backdated quiet windows.
deploy-bot: NOTE: add end-to-end smoke that asserts UI shows effective_burn when present.
